evidence.note: Large dark serif title on plain white; no texture or grain anywhere on the slide.
Three bullets in generous dark sans type with thick blue dash markers.
Three big rounded white cards with soft shadows and large dark labels; the connecting arrows are thin grey lines (about 2 px), the slide's only fine strokes.
At the small size, card labels and bullets stay clearly readable; the soft card shadows on white are faint but the cards are still defined, and the thin arrows remain visible.
The top nav and the 'Synthetic brief' italic are small, mid-grey text, but they are deck chrome, not slide content.

rationale: The slide content is big soft shapes and generous high-contrast type on a flat colour background, with no grain, texture or grid lines. The only fine strokes are the thin connector arrows, which carry no information that the card order does not already give, so compression losing them would not lose meaning. That fits the pass descriptor.
